Name: Letter Visitors
Tagline: See website visitors on your website itself
Description: Know who’s on your website: the people, their companies, and the AI agents reading your pages. See them on your own site, and replay their sessions.

Name: Gauth Personal Study Agent
Tagline: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle
Topics: Android, Education, Artificial Intelligence, Online Learning
Description: Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.

Name: Motionflare
Tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
Description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.

Name: Inkling 2 Mini
Tagline: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop
Description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.

Name: Polylane Swarms
Tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
Description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

Name: Ashwa
Tagline: Your AI companion that never forgets what you say
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Chat rooms
Description: Come back after 100 days, and Ashwa can still recall relevant details from your past conversations and diary entries. Pick up where you left off without repeating your story. Talk through your day, reflect in a private daily journal, and get responses shaped by the emotional context you've shared

Name: LeanTake
Tagline: 4.1 MB native Mac screen recorder — zero export wait
Description: Pure Swift + ScreenCaptureKit screen recorder for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon). Real-time hardware encoding writes finishedmov videos the second you hit Stop. Includes a 12-color live pen, region magnifier, 9 3D cat paw cursors, and a window-excluded stealth teleprompter. Free forever (no watermark, no login); optional Pro $14.99 one-time.

Name: Tesla Self-Driving V15
Tagline: Upgrading every part of the end-to-end driving network
Description: What's new in FSD V15: • 25x better handling of safety-critical cases • Tesla Reality View: a live generative view from a virtual camera above your car, so you see and control what FSD plans • Fullscreen, map, split or quiet mode • Nav turns in the visualization; quieter turn signals • Trip start/end routing learned from fleet route preferences • Better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water; smoother speed in school zones and bad weather

Name: Chat with Work
Tagline: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.
Description: Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.

Name: Strict
Tagline: Run GitHub Actions on any spare Mac or Linux machine
Description: Turn spare Macs and Linux boxes into a self-healing, auto load-balancing GitHub Actions fleet at $0/min compute. Includes a native macOS Liquid Glass app, 7-tier disk cleanup, preflight doctor, and Tailscale-native setup—zero account required.

Name: naturefunding.org
Tagline: Grants for nature projects, checked against funder pages
Topics: Charity & Giving, GitHub, Climate Tech, Social Impact
Description: A free directory of 1,000+ grants for nature restoration and conservation: forests, coasts, wetlands, wildlife and more. Every deadline, amount and eligibility rule links to the funder's own page, with its exact words and the date we checked it. Filter by place, deadline, who can apply and how to apply (directly, through a partner, or invitation only). No paid listings, no sign-up. Data is open (CC BY 4.0) as JSON, CSV and an Atom feed.

Name: freddy
Tagline: Private health data server: talk to your health with any AI
Description: freddy is your health data server. Connect your wearables, rings, glucose monitors, training apps, Apple Health and Health Connect once, and add your lab results. freddy keeps every value as the source sends it. Use it with any AI, export it, or build on it.

Name: Journalistic Tech
Tagline: Async interviews that get you published on HackerNoon
Description: Tell us what you do or what just happened. We match you to one of 273 technology interviews. Answer ~13 questions by voice or text, on your own time. Your answers become a bylined draft, an editor reviews and polishes it, then it publishes on HackerNoon and gets distributed around the web.

Name: Modem
Tagline: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern
Topics: Customer Success, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

Name: Plango
Tagline: Plango lets your AI agents work all night - safely
Description: AI is wreaking havoc in cybersecurity. You need a command center to protect your device and AI-agent setup. There are two major risks today: 1. External AI attackers finding exploits 2. Internal AI taking unsafe actions Plango researches and patches vulnerabilities while running entirely on-device. It finds where you're vulnerable and shows how to fix it. (example: you may be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks due to SSL certs compromised in October. Plango shows if you have them!)

Name: Omi Work
Tagline: Omi can build anything. Now it does your hardest work.
Description: Omi can build anything. Omi Work is an AI workspace for the hardest, longest jobs. Give it a goal: it shows the plan first, splits big work across sub-agents, searches the web, uses the apps you connect, keeps going after you close the tab, and hands back documents, sheets with formulas and slide decks. Ready-made teammates, scheduled tasks and voice mode. Teams get roles, SSO and an audit log. Free to start, no card.

Name: Open Source Solana Wallet
Tagline: Your own keys, your very own network
Description: A Solana wallet for iPhone and iPad with no backend. It connects directly to the RPC you choose: public Solana RPC, a provider with your own key, or any HTTPS URL. - Private balances for SOL, USDC, and USDT - Only the tokens you add, so no spam - Prices in your currency, from the built-in source, your own server, or none - Built-in themes, or build your own theme pack - Several windows on iPad and iPhone Duo - Open source

Name: Replit Missions
Tagline: Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents,
Description: Turn ambitious goals into outcomes with Replit Missions. Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents, and review progress against clear success criteria.

Name: Snowly
Tagline: Plan ski trips with friends. Remember every run.
Description: Snowly is a ski and snowboard app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Plan trips with friends, see your crew on the trail map, check the snow before you go, and let Snowly record every run on its own. Each day lands in your ski passport. Free, with no ads.

Name: Orpheus
Tagline: Run all your Claude subscriptions from one place
Description: Orpheus puts every Claude subscription you pay for on one board: weekly and 5-hour usage, forecast and reset. Move idle agents to the account with room, answer agents on every machine, and open Rooms where your team and your agents chat together.
